text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—And then, everyone at the castle praised 
me, saying 'Your Highness is the best at 
it,' so I got even more hooked on 
keepy-uppies...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Could the secret to Fine-san's 
strength be the leg power she built up 
from childhood...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, talking like this makes me want to 
play catch again for the first time in a 
while♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
! In that case, care to try it with me? To 
see who can last the longest!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's get right to it...! 
Ready, set—!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Yah! Ahaha! It's been so long since 
we did this~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Still, somehow my body feels different 
than before...? My center of gravity feels 
off... and my body feels heavy...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Looks like I dropped it 
first... The record is... 134 minutes, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I lasted 136 minutes... That was close! I 
used to be able to do 5 hours back in the 
day, but... Mm, maintaining both stamina 
and focus really is tough..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, please let me have a rematch next 
time! I promise I'll get better...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm♪ That's just what I was hoping 
for~! I need to shape up while practicing 
too♪

And so, after devoting herself to 
training, Fine Motion returned to her 
original weight.
